annotations.title: mlpeek: embed text and images in one vector space

description: mlpeek: Create multimodal embeddings: images and text in one vector space. For text only use embed_texts. Returns 768-dim vectors of texts and images (URL or base64) in ONE space (EmbeddingGemma 2), comparable by dot product; `dimensions` 512/256/128, `input_type` text prefix, `image_detail` low/standard/high. At most 16 low, 8 standard or 4 high-detail images (10 MB each, public URLs). Over 4,096 text tokens or a bad image (named by index) is a 422; an unavailable model a 503 (none charged). Typically 0.05 s per short text and 1.5-3 s per image (6.5 s at high detail), plus a few seconds on first use. Price: USD 0.002 per item (1-16 items per call: USD 0.002-0.032). Free: 5 mlpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/embeddings-rerank-ner-mcp-server.html

image_base64.description: An image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine).
image_base64.title: Image Base64

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO or AVIF; at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused).
image_url.title: Image Url

text.description: A text, at most 8,000 characters (cut at 2,048 tokens, reported per item).
text.title: Text

image_detail.description: Vision tokens per image: low (70), standard (140) or high (280, slowest). At most 16 low, 8 standard or 4 high images per call.
image_detail.title: Image Detail

input_type.description: Task prefix for text items (images get none): query (search query), document (search corpus), question, fact_check, code_query, classification, clustering, similarity or none.
input_type.title: Input Type

items.description: 1-16 items, each {text}, {image_url} or {image_base64}; every vector lands in one shared space. Priced per item.
items.title: Items

name: embed_multimodal

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
